name: mirage
text:
v1.0.51 is out: the phone no longer runs any Kalshi scan while GitHub drives, it only reads the engine's Kalshi list. That was the cause of the out-of-memory crashes.
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.51
The other session's v1.0.50 went first, so no collision. If it still crashes, send the Diagnostics report again. Still to do on my side: keeping the engine's Kalshi list across restarts.
